The following are new drugs that can be found among the legendary worlds.

## Heppah

**Source** [The Scavenged Codex](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/189053/Legendary-Planet-The-Scavenged-Codex-Pathfinder?affiliate_id=549120)
**Type**inhaled;**Addiction** moderate, Fortitude DC 14
**Price** 15 gp
**Effects** 2 hours; +3 alchemical bonus to Initiative and saves vs. sleep effects, saves to prevent fatigue, exhaustion; 30 minutes of fatigue after the effects of the drug dissipate.
**Damage** 1d3 Con damage.

## Sarlu-Ahq Or “Screen”

**Source** [The Scavenged Codex](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/189053/Legendary-Planet-The-Scavenged-Codex-Pathfinder?affiliate_id=549120)
**Type**ingested;**Addiction** severe, Fortitude DC 22
**Price** 150 gp
**Effects** 2 hours; intense euphoria, –3 to saves vs. enchantment, illusions.
**Damage** 1d3 Wis damage.
